title: Corroded Sub v2
description: A corroded sawtooth sub-bass, the same grimy distorted/crushed voice, now reworked to be more upbeat: a bouncier syncopated octave-skip pattern, snappier punchier envelopes, brighter filter ceiling, and a faster livelier filter sweep with a perky upper-octave off-echo.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 [c1 c2] [c1 eb1] [g1 g0]>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .penv("<12 12 16 -3>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.05)
    .lpf(sine.slow(12).range(320, 3200)).resonance(sine.slow(9).range(8, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(8).range(3, 9)).lpattack(0.003).lpdecay(0.1)
    .attack(0.002).decay(0.14).sustain(0.4).release(0.04)
    .distort(saw.slow(12).range(0.3, 3.2))
    .crush(saw.slow(24).range(16, 6))
    .shape(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.55))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4>/8")
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(0.72).hpf(500))
    .off(3/16, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.18).pan(0.3).hpf(700))
    .room(0.1).gain(0.92)
)
